name: Scale effects

subjectOf.text: Form PF compliance cost is sharply size dependent: quarterly filing large funds spent on average $155,286 on the initial filing, roughly sixteen times the $9,520 average reported by annually filing smaller funds.
subjectOf.abstract: Quarterly filing large funds spent on average $155,286 for the initial filing of Form PF. By contrast, annually filing smaller funds only spend on average $9,520 for the first time filing of Form PF.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Private Fund Disclosures Under the Dodd-Frank Act (2014). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2447306
scope_conditions: small sample of large quarterly filers

subjectOf.text: Growth in the private fund industry has been concentrated among the largest advisers: assets managed by advisers with more than $5 billion in AUM grew 141 percent, compared with 53 percent for firms below $5 billion.
subjectOf.abstract: The larger private fund advisers have generated most of the private fund industry's growth. Assets managed by private fund ad- visers with more than $5 billion AUM have grown 141%, compared to 53% for firms with less than $5 billion.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, The Post Dodd-Frank Act Evolution of the Private Fund Industry Comparative Evidence from 2012 and 2 (2016). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2739479

subjectOf.text: Smaller private funds spend more on compliance than larger ones, both as a share of AUM and relative to operating costs, which means increasing regulatory scrutiny falls disproportionately on smaller funds.
subjectOf.abstract: Smaller private funds spend more on compliance costs than their larger counterparts—both as a percentage of AUM and in relation to oper- ating costs; this suggests that increasing regulatory scrutiny disproportionately impacts smaller funds.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, The Post Dodd-Frank Act Evolution of the Private Fund Industry Comparative Evidence from 2012 and 2 (2016). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2739479
scope_conditions: private fund advisers subject to Dodd-Frank compliance obligations
compliance measured as share of AUM and of operating costs
